claims.text: On American Alchemy with Jesse Michels, 25 October 2025, at 0:22:14 to 0:23:09, Beatriz Villarroel said that since about the early 1960s there have been objects called uncorrelated targets, seen once or a few times on radar or optical sensors and then untrackable, and that these are subtracted from the background when the number of objects in space is calculated. claims.text: On American Alchemy with Jesse Michels, 25 October 2025, at 1:16:06 and 1:18:41, Michels said in narration that on 11 July 1961 Vallee, then working on the Paris Observatory's satellite tracking programme, and colleagues observed an object in retrograde orbit, and that his superior at the observatory, named as Paul Mueller, confiscated the tape the next morning and destroyed it.
